ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; surface area is approximately 98% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity pixels limited to specular highlights and water spray.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations along the trailing edge, characterized by low-amplitude peaks; edge topography becomes increasingly irregular and thickened at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on both lobes; the left lobe is disproportionately elongated and slender, while the right lobe is broader with a more standard convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters found at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment points or associated scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular bulbous masses at the distal tips of both lobes; the left lobe tip appears truncated with an unnatural, jagged termination.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly melanistic ventral pigmentation pattern (Type 1) with a total absence of macro-scale white focal spots or patches.
